WQA Convention & Exposition


The Water Quality Association (WQA) is a non-profit association for the residential commercial, and industrial water treatment industry. WQA has more than 2,500 member companies around the world.
WQA plays a role in the certifier of water treatment products and voice of the water quality improvement industry.
The WQA Convention & Exposition is the premier water treatment industry education, sales and networking event. The convention helps dealers, manufacturers and consultants find ways to solve the challenges of the industry.
The show will be held in Las Vegas. It will last for three days from April 23th to 25th.
Our partner, Arrow Induesites, Booth Number: 1029
If you want to have a meeting with us.
Please use the email to contact us.

 

About Aquasky
Aquasky Enterprise Corp. provides end-to-end pressure tank manufacturing solutions, proved the best quality pressure tank to support international distributors serving in the residential water cleaning, water heater, air conditioning and solar water heater as well as the residential and commercial pumping system.
Our Goal is to provide top quality, dependable pressure tank to our customers at a competitive price time after time. Our end-to end manufacturing solution provides a stable price list, the fastest custom design option and the on time delivery.
